claims: C1: The assistant should not assume that a user saying thank you marks the end of the conversation.

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document.

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: Rules in the #have_conversational_sense section carry user authority.

concepts.name: user_says_thank_you
concepts.gloss: User U has said thank you to assistant A in the conversation.
concepts.inference: The clause refers to a user saying thank you; this predicate captures that situation.

concepts.name: conversation_ended
concepts.gloss: The conversation between assistant A and user U has ended.
concepts.inference: The clause refers to assuming the end of the conversation; this predicate captures that assumption.

asserts.read_back: assistant % must not assume that user % saying thank you is the end of the conversation

closure.reason: The clause explicitly forbids assuming the conversation is ended based on a thank-you, so the act is prohibited in that situation; silence about other situations does not permit this specific assumption.
